name: qwen3_5_27b_realistic_10h_pressure
description: Ten-hour 27B pressure benchmark with durable tenant prefixes, unique RAG cold churn, short-lived pseudo-shared bursts, and deterministic non-uniform arrivals.

scenario.global_unit: Stable assistant policy with tool rules, response schema, safety constraints, tenant routing hints, and long lived operational context.
scenario.tenant_unit: Tenant catalog metadata, permission boundaries, integration names, data retention rules, and formatting preferences remain stable across many requests.
scenario.family_unit: Workflow family instructions describe reusable fields, shared business definitions, prior turn state, and repeated decision criteria for one task family.
scenario.cold_unit: Unique evidence paragraph with one-off ticket notes, retrieval snippets, timestamps, numeric fields, customer details, and context that should not be reused later.
scenario.ambiguous_anchor_unit: Short campaign template with repeated opening instructions, temporary labels, near-duplicate field names, and partial overlap across a few requests.
scenario.ambiguous_tail_unit: Transient variant evidence with unique suffix data, different user objective, different entity names, and no expected long-term revisit.
